sources.label: Morphe patch bundle that removes ads from TimeTree (works.jubilee.timetree)
sources.author: TimeTree Ad Remover
patch_list: Forces every boolean in the server-driven AdsConfigModel to false, so no ad slot is created at all. Reads the fields at patch time, so it is not tied to obfuscated field names.

Emits AdsAdModel.Empty for every ad placement, so calendar banners, in-feed ad cards and premium-upsell ad slots are never rendered. Anchored on unobfuscated domain types and reuses the app's own method ids.
Forces the splash ad screen to take its built-in "no ad to show" path, so no full screen ad covers the app on cold start.

sources.label: Blelle
sources.author: Blelle
patch_list: Completely removes all ads (calendar headlines, activities banner, event creation ads, daily ads, and splash interstitials) and unlocks premium ad-free mode.
